files.decision: Automatic status functions bypass implicit prerequisite success; bounded original/candidate controls are filed upstream as #27.
All four captured source subtrees remain current CI inputs; all 221 files are present in the conservative reference graph. Path history alone does not exclude execution.
Commit errors throw, but branch/tag push return values are discarded before successful release outputs. Real local rejection controls reproduce both boundaries.
add/commit/tag use mustRun; both publication methods return unchecked Process::run results. Disposable candidate changes those two calls only.
Separates status-bearing run from throwing mustRun. Existing Formal AI release commands already propagate nonzero pushes.
An unsuccessful process remains a structured result until the caller inspects ok() or uses mustRun.
Locates manifest, reads identity/version, edits the version field and identifies the sentinel package; valid-input release fixture retains this implementation.
Packagist and receive-pack probes distinguish verified, failed and unknown; the receive-pack path checks a complete advertisement without changing refs.
Registry/GitHub state and fragments drive new-release versus self-heal selection. This review alone is not live registry verification.
Actual CLI emits version_committed=true after the unchecked release method. Both changeset and instant modes are executed in the regression.
Falls back to local PSR-4 loading when Composer vendor code is absent; release reproduction installs no packages.
Existing tests deliberately omit a remote and accept silent push failures, covering local commit/tag creation but missing publication rejection.
Valid fragments are selected deterministically, merged by category and cleared during a release. The real-Git controls retain both release modes and successful fragment consumption.
Existing version parsing and bump precedence are retained; regression uses a valid patch bump with exact 1.2.4 remote content.
Preserves the existing insertion marker behavior used by the release fixture; no changelog implementation is copied into production.
Normalizes getopt string/flag inputs; regression executes the original CLI with its supported equals-form options.
Release outputs are inspected through the actual GITHUB_OUTPUT file, keeping process success distinct from remote publication state.
